Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

hurt verb

also feel pain, ache, it hurts, my head hurts, my stomach hurts, what hurts?, my back is sore, sore, aching, does it hurt?, I ache all over

classical

Traupman 62: mūsculus mihi dolet, my muscle aches
Traupman 65: tergum mihi dolet, my back is sore; dolēns, sore, aching
Traupman 55: Stomachus meus dolet. Caput meum dolet. Quid dolet?

doleō, dolēre, doluī, dolitum

verb, second conjugation

hurt, feel pain or grieve

Examples

  • Quid tibi dolet?

    What hurts?composed

  • Bracchium mihi dolet.

    My arm hurts.composed

  • Quid dolet?

    What hurts?Traupman 55

  • Caput dolet; stomachus dolet; faucēs dolent.

    My head hurts; my stomach hurts; my throat hurts.Traupman 56

  • Tōtus doleō.

    I ache all over.Traupman 268

  • dolōre afficī

    to feel painTraupman 314

See also cry, comfort, suffer.

SourcesLewis & Short: doleo

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
